prompt:
Image 1 is the finished sheet; image 2 is its layout: 2 building outlines seen from above on flat magenta, in a 1×2 grid. Redraw only cell 1 (the transparent area). Keep the other cell exactly as it is, and match its style, colours and fine detail.

The faults in cell 1: its light well shows the courtyard walls from the side, with rows of windows, as if seen at an angle. Seen straight down, a light well shows no walls and no windows: it is a small flat dark grey paved courtyard floor, about 6 × 4 m, framed by the roof's inner eaves. Its chimney stacks are about 1.8 m across; each must be about 0.6–0.8 m, a third of that size.

For the redrawn cell, trace the outline in image 2 exactly, keep its proportions, straight square edges, top-down with no perspective, and keep the magenta background flat pure #FF00FF outside it. Details at true size: this building stands beside cars 4 m long; a chimney is about 0.6 m, a dormer about 1.5 m wide, sheet ribs about 0.25 m apart. No text.

1. 24.7 × 20.8 m (1.2× wider than deep) — deep old-town apartment block, hipped roof of grey sheet metal round a light well, dormers and chimney stacks
